subject: HEXOS-4: home directory — one addressable per-user object over ModuleProgress, badges and transcript
description:
The last non-conditional Hex OS phase (scope: _docs/architecture/hex-os-scope.md:94-96). Touches student data, so it goes behind HEXOS-0/1/2/3/5, all of which are now shipped. BLOCKED ON A DATA-INTEGRITY PROBLEM FIRST: the stores this would unify already disagree. See BUG-236..241 in _docs/operations/BUG_TRACKER.md. Unifying them as-is would launder existing disagreement into a single authoritative record, which is worse than leaving them separate. BUG-241 (a passing retake with a lower score overwrites the higher) needs an operator decision - best-score or latest-score - before any unified read model can state a grade.
[2026-09-01 00:35] HEXOS-4 shipped 2026-08-31 as a READ MODEL (HomeDirectory.js) plus its page (/home.html), linked from the dashboard and registered as 'run home'. It never writes; the gate enforces that by grepping every write form and loading the module under a proxy that throws on storage access. Conflicts between sources are SURFACED rather than resolved, because the stores already disagree (BUG-236..242) and a unified write store would launder that. Required a firestore.rules change to grant students read on their own server_awards and quiz_attempts.
